title: Stage2-L v11 matched-U identifiability dataset preflight result

historical_preupgrade_diagnosis.reason: The immutable source records used route_context.v1 and did not contain the exact current ORION speedometer reading. This is retained as pre-upgrade diagnostic evidence, not as the terminal dataset result.

matched_invariants_proven: byte-identical visual observation within each group
identical route command, unmodified ORION plan and exact current speedometer reading within each group
identical independently constructed R supervision within each group
identical Stage1 checkpoint lineage within each group
on-path and off-path U match total mass, peak and positive support count within frozen FP32 tolerances
on-path and off-path U have spatially distinct support
train and dev group identities remain separate and locked test is unread

verification.pytest_command: PYTHONPATH=. python -m pytest -q tests/test_stage2l_identifiability.py tests/test_audit_stage2l_v11_identifiability_dataset.py tests/test_upgrade_stage2l_v11_route_context.py tests/test_build_uq_relevance_frame_bundles.py tests/test_uq_relevance_qa_factory.py tests/test_uq_relevance_tokenizer.py tests/test_stage2l_bridge_runtime.py tests/test_stage2l_semantic_runtime_v10.py tests/test_stage2l_view_aligned_queries.py

next_gate.allowed_now: Implement and CPU-test one v11 model path that computes R once, reuses bitwise-identical R logits across matched U variants, derives K, scores matched QA preferences and executes a no-U ablation.
next_gate.not_automatically_allowed: A GPU run still requires a separate hash-bound launch amendment after the model-output-side implementation and tests pass.

claim_boundary: The versioned 17-event inputs satisfy the frozen matched-counterfactual dataset contract. This does not show that R is held-out-generalizing, that a VLM uses U, that learned U is valid, that QA is grounded, or that planning and closed-loop safety improve.
